items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I didn't play with Hilton Jefferson until I 'got to Calloway's band

ctx.x: How long did you stay with that band then, Brother?

Well, I stayed with that band from December 7, 1930, to about May 1932. And there was a little discrepancy in the band then. Don had left the band and Bennie Carter came but Bennie wasn't that interested in the band either. So Bennie did some writing and all that. So Rex Stewart had come with the band at the time. Buddy Lee had left and went to New York with Don.

So Rex left and went to New York and he called me back and he said, "Fletcher would like to have you in his band." He said, "Why don't you come to New York?" So Bennie Carter was going, coming to New York, too, he and Hilton Jefferson because Hilton Jefferson was in the band, in McKinney's band at the time, too.
